  stairs: (mat, facing, half = "bottom", shape = "straight") => [`${mat}_stairs`, { facing, half, shape, waterlogged: "false" }],
  slab: (mat, type = "bottom") => [`${mat}_slab`, { type, waterlogged: "false" }],
  log: (mat, axis = "y") => [`${mat}_log`, { axis }],
  wood: (mat, axis = "y") => [`${mat}_wood`, { axis }],
  pillar: (block, axis = "y") => [block, { axis }],
  trapdoor: (mat, facing, half = "bottom", open = false) => [`${mat}_trapdoor`, { facing, half, open: String(open), powered: "false", waterlogged: "false" }],
  door: (mat, facing, half = "lower", hinge = "left") => [`${mat}_door`, { facing, half, hinge, open: "false", powered: "false" }],
  fence: (mat) => [`${mat}_fence`, {}],
  wall: (mat) => [`${mat}_wall`, {}],
  pane: (block = "glass_pane") => [block, {}],
  lantern: (hanging = false) => ["lantern", { hanging: String(hanging), waterlogged: "false" }],
  chain: (axis = "y", version26 = true) => [version26 ? "iron_chain" : "chain", { axis, waterlogged: "false" }],

  block: (name) => [name, {}],
  /**
   * A banner with patterns: [block, state, nbt] for g.set(x, y, z, ...B.banner(...)). patterns: [[pattern, colour], ...]
   * (ids such as stripe_center, border, cross, rhombus, flower, globe, gradient, half_horizontal, curly_border).
   * wall: hung on the block behind it, facing `facing`; standing: `rotation` 0..15 (0 faces south). legacy: the
   * pre-1.20.5 Patterns/Pattern/Color form (for 1.20.4 and older).
   */
  banner: (color, patterns = [], { wall = true, facing = "north", rotation = 0, legacy = false } = {}) => {
    const block = wall ? `${color}_wall_banner` : `${color}_banner`, state = wall ? { facing } : { rotation: String(rotation) };
    const pats = patterns.map((p) => (Array.isArray(p) ? { pattern: p[0], color: p[1] } : p));
    const nbt = legacy
      ? t.compound({ id: t.string("minecraft:banner"), Patterns: t.list("compound", pats.map((p) => ({ Pattern: t.string(LEGACY_PATTERN[p.pattern] ?? p.pattern), Color: t.int(DYE_INDEX.indexOf(p.color)) }))) })
      : t.compound({ id: t.string("minecraft:banner"), patterns: t.list("compound", pats.map((p) => ({ pattern: t.string(`minecraft:${p.pattern.replace(/^minecraft:/, "")}`), color: t.string(p.color) }))) });
    return [block, state, nbt];
  },
  /**
   * A sign with text: [block, state, nbt]. lines: up to 4 strings (front); back: up to 4 more. wood "oak", "spruce" ...
   * wall (facing) or standing (rotation 0..15); hanging: a hanging sign. color: dye name; glow: glowing text.
   * dataVersion: text is written as JSON components before 1.21.5 (4325) and as plain string components after.
   */
  sign: (wood = "oak", lines = [], { wall = true, facing = "north", rotation = 0, hanging = false, color = "black", glow = false, back = [], dataVersion = 4189 } = {}) => {
    const block = `${wood}_${wall ? "wall_" : ""}${hanging ? "hanging_" : ""}sign`;
    const state = wall ? { facing, waterlogged: "false" } : { rotation: String(rotation), waterlogged: "false", ...(hanging ? { attached: "false" } : {}) };
    const msg = (s) => t.string(dataVersion >= 4325 ? String(s ?? "") : JSON.stringify({ text: String(s ?? "") }));
    const side = (ls) => ({ messages: t.list("string", [0, 1, 2, 3].map((i) => msg(ls[i]).value)), color: t.string(color), has_glowing_text: t.byte(glow ? 1 : 0) });

    return [block, state, nbt];
  },
